text.text_excerpt: Best bar on Bourbon street, hands down. Friendly, welcoming, dive bar with an incredibly interesting history. We were here on an afternoon, just whiling away some time while out wandering around and had a great time. We hit this place twice because we loved it so much. The drinks weren't out of the ordinary, but those Scarlett O'Haras they mixed up for me were hella refreshing and tasty. What was out of the ordinary was the fun ambiance, the fantastic, cute bartender and just the general vibe of "You are welcome here." Maybe it's just me that gets that from gay bars, but so be it - it's my opinion that they are friendlier than "straight" bars, especially to women, so take that as you wish...

Stopped in one late afternoon for a drink and a break from the craziness that is the French Quarter. Was immediately welcomed by the upstairs bartender. Since it was early in the evening (for New Orleans anyway), it was just myself and the bartender upstairs, so we talked about New Orleans in general, and the history of the bar. He also made a real good drink for me too. After a while other patrons started coming upstairs, and they joined in the conversation. Felt very comfortable there. Unfortunately I didn't stay long enough for the "night activities", but when I come back to New Orleans, I look forward to coming back.

If you don't know the history of this bar, check it out online before you go. It's pretty incredible. We stopped in for a drink on our way to check out the rest of Bourbon St. My mixed drink (vodka with cranberry juice) was $2.75, a GREAT value and price compared to other venues on Bourbon St. Other places charged at least twice that and went VERY heavy on the cranberry and very light on the vodka. Not Lafitte in Exile! ++++ It was very clean inside and we liked how there was an upstairs with a balcony so you could sit outside and enjoy a view of Bourbon St in a relaxed atmosphere. We sat out there for awhile and enjoyed the cool breeze and bright lights. My only complaint would be the up...
